topic_title: How to Get Started + Competition's Official Discord

messages.author: (Kaggle Staff - official)
messages.content_summary: Official 'Information for First Timers' + 'Competition's Official Discord' sticky. Links to Kaggle etiquette/lingo/how-to-enter videos, Team Up feature, community guidelines. Official Discord: discord.gg/kaggle. Two key rules: (1) Discord competition channels are 'public' — private sharing of code/data outside team not permitted, code sharing must be public via Kaggle forums/notebooks; (2) Discord channels are NOT monitored by Kaggle Staff/Hosts — keep important questions/insights/writeups on the Kaggle forums. Discord is casual space only.

messages.author: (Kaggle Staff)
messages.content_summary: Clarification: tips and useful information related to the competition should generally be posted in the official Kaggle Discussion forums. Sharing information ONLY on X or other channels is not recommended and MAY BE A RULE VIOLATION if not publicly available for all participants.

messages.author: (participant)
messages.content_summary: Participant asks: unable to post in the #pokemon-tcg-ai-battle Discord channel, how to get permission to post there. (No reply captured in this topic.)

messages.author: Grogoat
messages.content_summary: Participant 'Grogoat' asks: are participants expected to submit (1) an agent specialized for a single deck chosen by the team, or (2) a general-purpose agent capable of playing multiple decks? Is the deck fixed throughout evaluation or may agents be tested with different decks?

messages.author: (Host/Staff reply to Grogoat)
messages.content_summary: Official reply: preferred submission method is to zip a main.py file (the agent that plays the deck) and a deck.csv file it reads from. You're allowed two active submissions at any time, can make multiple submissions as meta materializes, but only most recent two are active — may need to resubmit if a better agent is pushed out. EXPECTATION IS #1 (single-deck-specialized agent), but you can have two active and change up your submission as you wish.
